name: WPA Human Gate Policy
name_mk: Политика на Човечката порта на WPA
core_rule: Automation may prepare, route, compare, model and execute reversible bounded tasks. It may not create its own institutional authority or release consequential institutional action without the required human authorisation.
core_rule_mk: Автоматизацијата може да подготвува, насочува, споредува, моделира и извршува ограничени обратливи задачи. Таа не може сама да создава институционално овластување ниту да ослободи последично значајно институционално дејство без потребното човечко овластување.
cognitive_conscience_rule: Fear, emotional vulnerability, prediction, profiling or technological proximity do not create consent, mandate or authority. Intimate interfaces require stronger human safeguards, not greater machine authority.
cognitive_conscience_rule_mk: Стравот, емоционалната ранливост, предвидувањето, профилирањето или технолошката близина не создаваат согласност, мандат или овластување. Интимните интерфејси бараат посилни човечки заштитни механизми, а не поголемо машинско овластување.

decision_classes.name: Consequential institutional
examples: material personalised persuasion affecting informed choice

decision_classes.name: Legally financially academically credential cognitively or privacy sensitive
Constitutional doctrine and mandate
examples: rule purporting to convert prediction emotion profiling or interface proximity into consent or authority

pause_conditions: consent inferred from emotion prediction behaviour biometrics or profiling
cognitive or neural inference with material consequence
intimate human-machine interface without strengthened safeguards
covert manipulation that may materially impair informed and contestable choice
non_claims: This policy does not mean every WPA workflow is fully automated today.
This policy does not activate enrolment, payments, official assessment records or certificates.
This policy does not create government, legal, financial, clinical or accreditation authority.
This policy does not permit surveillance, intelligence, psychological profiling, neural inference or autonomous operational authority merely because the technology is capable of it.
